subject: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)

Team —

Im formally requesting executive-level headcount authorization for Q4 to accelerate two strategic initiatives: the Edge Inference product line and the Partner Integrations org. High level:

• Roles requested (2 FTE, executive level):
  - VP, Product (Edge Inference) — req to ship GA for on-prem/private customers and partnerships
  - Head of Partner Integrations — req to own marketplace and cloud partner programs
• Proposed comp bands (total cash + target equity): see attached comp-band-2027-q4.pdf
  - VP, Product: $280k–$360k base, 30–40% target bonus, 0.6–1.2% eq (depending on level)
  - Head of Partner Integrations: $240k–$320k base, 25–35% target bonus, 0.4–0.9% eq
• Timing: aim to extend offers by 2027-10-15, start target 2027-11-01 to align with Q4 launch milestones
• Justification: these are customer-facing, revenue-accretive roles that reduce time-to-revenue for Dedicated and Private deployments. We have three enterprise prospects where deal velocity depends on product and partner readiness; estimated uplift: +$8–12M ARR over 18 months if staffed now.

Attached: exec-hc-plan-Q4.xlsx (role-level budget, org reporting, run-rate impact), comp-band-2027-q4.pdf.

Ask: approval to commit two executive headcount slots and sign-off on comp band ceilings so TA can initiate searches. If you prefer, we can run one as contingent (offer with performance milestone).

Thanks — I can be on a quick call this afternoon to walk through the numbers.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Finance & Strategy (acting)
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)

Karthik —

Thanks for the concise plan. A couple quick items before Im comfortable greenlighting both roles:

1) Run-rate & budget impact: I need a 12-month cash-flow view (OPEX + hiring comp at midpoint and high) showing incremental burn and breakeven assumptions tied to the $8–12M ARR projection. Can you add sensitivity if hires slip 3 months?

2) Contingency plan: prefer we stagger by 6 weeks if TA pipeline looks thin. Approve the Partner Integrations role first and the VP, Product contingent on a candidate slate and product milestone (integration adapter delivered).

3) Equity ceiling: the bands look slightly high at the top end for VP; ask Laura to confirm comp committee comfort and comparable market comps.

If you can get the 12-month cash view to me by end of day, Ill call in the approval. Otherwise, we can do a 20-minute sync at 3pm today.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
CEO, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)

Karthik / Vivek —

Reviewed comp-band-2027-q4.pdf and the requested ceilings. A few notes from Comp & Talent:

• Market context: for both roles, comps were benchmarked against peers at similar-scale infra/enterprise AI companies (mid-stage). The VP band midpoint is competitive; the top end assumes strong prior enterprise product leadership and accelerated hiring urgency.
• Equity policy: for executive hires we prefer 0.5%–0.9% for VP-level external hires. The 1.2% top-end you proposed is outside standard range; we can approve up to 1.0% with an acceleration schedule tied to milestone 1 (GA/partnership signed). Anything higher requires comp committee review.
• Hiring approvals process: we will need formal headcount authorization in Workday and a completed Hiring Authorization form. I have pre-populated the form in Drive (link below) — once you confirm role descriptions I can push to TA to open searches.

Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c_exec-hc-plan-Q4

If we adopt the staggered approach Vivek suggested (Partner Integrations first), Comp can provision a slightly lower cash offer band for the second hire if timelines slip.

Thanks — I can join the 3pm sync if needed.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)

All — quick operational note: TA has one vetted shortlist from GreenPoint Ventures for Partner Integrations (3 candidates), and an active exec search firm for the VP product role that expects a slate by mid-May. If we want offers in October Id recommend starting the Partner role immediately.

Operational ask: can we approve the Partner Integrations role today (Ill instruct TA to convert the shortlist to offers with the comp band Laura confirms)? For the VP role, I support Viveks conditional approval path — allow TA to run search but require the milestone for final offer.

If approved, I will:
• instruct TA to extend offer letters (standard Redwood template) to Partner Integrations candidates with target start dates 11/1;
• set offer contingencies (standard background + GDPR checks) and include a 6-month milestone clause for VP offer finalization.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Authorization request: Q4 executive headcount (VP/Head hires)

Thanks all — appreciate the quick responses.

Vivek: attached is a 12-month cash-flow sensitivity (tab 4 in exec-hc-plan-Q4.xlsx) showing midpoint and high-case burn and the ARR phasing that supports the $8–12M estimate; it includes a +3 month slip scenario. Laura: we will cap VP equity at 1.0% and route any above-ceiling ask to the comp committee. Marcus: you have approval to proceed with the Partner Integrations hire immediately.

Decisions / next steps (agreed):
• APPROVE: Partner Integrations (Head) — TA to extend offers this week to GreenPoint shortlist (Marcus to run).
• CONDITIONAL APPROVAL: VP, Product — TA to continue search; final offer contingent on candidate slate and product milestone (integration adapter shipped). Equity ceiling set at 1.0% without comp committee escalation.
• Admin: Laura to file headcount authorization in Workday and tag as Q4 executive bucket.

Ill notify Finance and Board Finance Office for bookkeeping. Sending Marcus the final offer bands to include in the offer packages.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Finance & Strategy (acting)
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: exec-hc-plan-Q4.xlsx (spreadsheet), comp-band-2027-q4.pdf (policy)
